cards.ex: Saying their situations are the same is like comparing apples to oranges; they're completely different.
cards.exUz: Ularning vaziyatlari bir xil deyish, o'rinsiz taqqoslashga o'xshaydi; ular butunlay farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash bo'lmagan narsalarni taqqoslash, noto'g'ri solishtirish.

cards.ex: There's a subtle distinction between being assertive and being aggressive.
cards.exUz: Qat'iyatli bo'lish bilan tajovuzkor bo'lish o'rtasida nozik farq bor.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik sezilmaydigan, lekin muhim bo'lgan farq.

cards.ex: His management style is not unlike hers; they both value teamwork.
cards.exUz: Uning boshqaruv uslubi uning uslubiga o'xshash; ularning ikkalasi ham jamoaviy ishlashni qadrlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga o'xshash, farqi unchalik katta emas.

cards.ex: To all intents and purposes, the project is finished; we just need to finalize the paperwork.
cards.exUz: Aslida, loyiha tugallandi; biz faqat hujjatlarni yakunlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aslida, amalda, farqi yo'q hisobi.

cards.ex: Optimism and pessimism are just different sides of the same coin; it depends on your perspective.
cards.exUz: Optimistlik va pessimistlik - bir tanga ikki tomoni; bu sizning nuqtai nazaringizga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil vaziyatning ikki xil, lekin bog'liq jihatlari.

cards.ex: Her lifestyle now is a world away from the poverty she experienced as a child.
cards.exUz: Uning hozirgi turmush tarzi bolaligida boshidan kechirgan qashshoqlikdan juda uzoq.
cards.uzDef: Katta farqga ega, juda boshqacha.

cards.ex: In a similar vein, the second proposal aims to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
cards.exUz: Shunga o'xshash, ikkinchi taklif chiqindilarni kamaytirish va samaradorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash uslubda, o'xshash mavzuda.

cards.ex: It's interesting to draw a parallel between the current economic crisis and the one in the 1930s.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi iqtisodiy inqiroz bilan 1930-yillardagi inqiroz o'rtasida o'xshashlik topish qiziq.
cards.uzDef: Ikkita narsa o'rtasida o'xshashlikni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Politically, they're poles apart; they disagree on almost everything.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy jihatdan, ular butunlay qarama-qarshi; ular deyarli hamma narsada kelishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nuqtai nazar, fikrlar yoki xususiyatlar bo'yicha butunlay qarama-qarshi bo'lish.

cards.ex: The common denominator among successful entrepreneurs is their willingness to take risks.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorlar o'rtasidagi umumiy omil - bu xavfni o'z zimmalariga olishga tayyorliklari.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar yoki narsalar o'rtasidagi umumiy jihat.

cards.ex: He's a risk-taker, while she's very cautious; they're not cut from the same cloth.
cards.exUz: U tavakkal qiluvchi, u esa juda ehtiyotkor; ular boshqa xarakterli odamlar.
cards.uzDef: Xulq-atvori, shaxsiyati boshqacha bo'lgan odamlar.

cards.ex: The resemblance between the two paintings is uncanny; they look almost identical.
cards.exUz: Ikki rasm o'rtasidagi o'xshashlik hayratlanarli; ular deyarli bir xil ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshashlik juda kuchli, g'ayrioddiy darajada.

cards.ex: The two proposals differ in degree; one is more ambitious than the other.
cards.exUz: Ikki taklif darajada farq qiladi; biri boshqasidan ko'ra ulkanroq.
cards.uzDef: Asosan bir xil, lekin miqdori yoki intensivligi bo'yicha farqlanadi.

cards.ex: There's a striking similarity between their leadership styles.
cards.exUz: Ularning liderlik uslublari o'rtasida ajoyib o'xshashlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha ko'zga tashlanadigan kuchli o'xshashlik.

cards.ex: His optimism contrasts sharply with her pessimism.
cards.exUz: Uning optimizmi uning pessimizmiga keskin qarama-qarshi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va osonlikcha ko'zga tashlanadigan farq.

cards.ex: For all practical purposes, the two options are one and the same.
cards.exUz: Amalda, ikkala variant ham bir xil.
cards.uzDef: Aslida bir xil narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: To me, all these reality TV shows are much of a muchness.
cards.exUz: Men uchun barcha realiti-shoular deyarli bir xil.
cards.uzDef: Asosan bir xil, unchalik farqi yo'q.

cards.ex: The two approaches are markedly different in their implementation.
cards.exUz: Ikki yondashuv o'zlarining amalga oshirilishida sezilarli farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha ko'rinadigan muhim farq.

cards.ex: He's willing to compromise, but she's not; therein lies the difference.
cards.exUz: U murosaga tayyor, lekin u emas; farq shu yerda.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy farq aynan shu nuqtada.

cards.ex: The coral reef is a world of its own, teeming with life and color.
cards.exUz: Marjon qoyalari o'z olami, hayot va rangga to'la.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan butunlay ajralib turadigan, o'ziga xos xususiyatlarga ega.

cards.ex: By way of contrast, let's consider the opposing argument.
cards.exUz: Farq sifatida, qarama-qarshi dalilni ko'rib chiqaylik.
cards.uzDef: Farqni ko'rsatish uchun.

cards.ex: A homemade meal is hardly the same as fast food.
cards.exUz: Uyda tayyorlangan ovqat tez ovqatlanish bilan deyarli bir xil emas.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil emas, sezilarli farq bor.

cards.ex: It's important to draw a distinction between fact and opinion.
cards.exUz: Fakt va fikr o'rtasida farqni ko'rsatish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlash va ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: It's often a matter of degree; both options are good, but one is slightly better.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha bu daraja masalasi; ikkala variant ham yaxshi, lekin biri biroz yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Farq faqat miqdor yoki intensivlikda.

cards.ex: His skills are on a par with the best players in the league.
cards.exUz: Uning mahorati ligadagi eng yaxshi o'yinchilar bilan bir xil darajada.
cards.uzDef: Sifati, qobiliyati yoki holati bo'yicha bir xil.

cards.ex: Their personalities are as different as night and day; he's outgoing, and she's reserved.
cards.exUz: Ularning xarakterlari tun va kundek farqli; u kirishimli, u esa kamgap.
cards.term: as different as night and day
cards.uzDef: Juda farqli, hech qanday o'xshashlik yo'q.

cards.ex: The poverty of the slums stands in stark contrast to the wealth of the city center.
cards.exUz: Chakana uylarning qashshoqligi shahar markazining boyligi bilan keskin farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va sezilarli farq.

cards.ex: Both languages share a characteristic of having complex verb conjugations.
cards.exUz: Ikkala til ham murakkab fe'l tuslanishlariga ega bo'lish xususiyatiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil xususiyatni yoki sifatni baham ko'rish.

cards.ex: The film bears little resemblance to the original novel.
cards.exUz: Film asl romanga ozgina o'xshashlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Unga ozgina o'xshashlik bor, farq sezilarli.

cards.ex: If you think I'm angry, nothing could be further from the truth.
cards.exUz: Agar meni g'azablangan deb o'ylasangiz, unday emas.
cards.uzDef: Mutlaqo aksi, haqiqatdan uzoq.
